name: Shokushin
source:
For monsters, spiritual power is something horrifying and at the same time a superb meal.
Tonight again, monster with tentacles attack girls who have the spiritual power.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE047351.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
对于怪物来说，精神力是一种恐怖的东西，同时也是一顿美餐。
今晚，长着触手的怪物再次袭击拥有灵力的少女。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE047351.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
